name: discussion-structure-diagnosis
description: Diagnose the structural completeness and move ordering of the Discussion section in an English psychology research paper. Checks whether the draft contains expected moves (revisit results, map to literature, identify applications, limitations, future work, achievement/contribution statement) and whether the order is logical and mirrors the Introduction's Block 1-4 symmetry.
author: UX Course Project - Discussion Group

clawhub.theory_basis: Glasman-Deal (2021) Science Research Writing Unit 4.2 (Generic Discussion Model) + 4.1.1 (narrative wrap)
